evidence: The kit maps five audience pains to five live localized workflow pages instead of promoting an undifferentiated feature list.
A seven-day sprint and thirty-day cadence prioritize replies, rule checks, and repeatable follow-up over broadcast volume.
Every channel has a purpose, draft, and completion signal; no automated third-party posting is proposed.
Reddit, Hacker News, V2EX, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, and other channels require a rule check and platform-specific adaptation before use.
Developer affiliation, human review, checksum verification, and stop conditions are explicit.
No bots, paid stars, reciprocal-star schemes, misleading urgency, or private-data requests are included.
Pagination thresholds, display-only repair, conversion formats, qualified OCR paths, BibTeX behavior, presentation reuse, license, and platform boundaries match the approved corpus.
HarmonyOS is correctly described as an ArkTS source project with no prebuilt HAP.
The ledger records stars only as a weekly GitHub-reported signal and does not promise a count or date.

conditions: Do not publish any channel until its current rules have been checked.
Do not cross-post identical bodies or automate third-party communities.
Record actual links, replies, issues, downloads, and weekly star snapshots.
Pause a channel if reply debt, moderator objection, or broken release evidence appears.
